leadText: Helping the Hometown Hero! (Japanese: 凱旋！アローラチャンピオン！！ A Triumphant Return! The Alola Champion!!) is the 112th episode of , and the 1,197th episode of the Pokémon animated series. It first aired in Japan on May 27, 2022, in Canada on November 5, 2022, in South Africa on December 27, 2022, in the United Kingdom on January 13, 2023, in Australia on January 15, 2023, and in the United States on February 24, 2023.
plainText:
Helping the Hometown Hero! (Japanese: 凱旋！アローラチャンピオン！！ A Triumphant Return! The Alola Champion!!) is the 112th episode of , and the 1,197th episode of the Pokémon animated series. It first aired in Japan on May 27, 2022, in Canada on November 5, 2022, in South Africa on December 27, 2022, in the United Kingdom on January 13, 2023, in Australia on January 15, 2023, and in the United States on February 24, 2023.
 

==Blurb==
 
 
 With Lillie’s family reunited, Ash, Goh, and Chloe accompany them home to Alola. The visit gives Ash a chance to show how much his skills have grown since he became the region’s Champion: a Battle Royal has been scheduled, and Professor Kukui, Gladion, and Kiawe are his opponents! The battling is intense, and the Battle Royal Dome is packed with people cheering for Ash and wishing him success in the upcoming Masters Eight Tournament. After the event, Ash heads to the beach, where he’s soon joined by Professor Kukui and Tapu Koko. The Island Guardian gives Ash a show of support, and our hero vows to give it his all! 

==Plot==
 
Following 's family reunion at the Crown Tundra, , Goh, and Chloe have joined the Aether family on a journey back to Alola, with Chloe being excited to visit the region for the first time. They arrive on Melemele Island, where 's family has organized a big feast to celebrate Mohn's homecoming. Lillie is overjoyed to meet again, while Hobbes, , and Wicke are shedding tears for seeing Mohn return home safe and sound. While everyone and their Pokémon feast, Chloe's Eevee meets 's , Sandy, and they quickly befriend each other. Chloe goes over to Lana to talk about Sandy, telling her how she and her Eevee have met many of Eevee's Evolutions, but are still unsure which of them she should choose. Lana tells Chloe that there's also one more possible path to consider: not evolving Eevee at all, similar to how Ash's Pikachu has chosen not to evolve. Meanwhile, Goh notices the absence of , which is explained to be due to him having gone off to at Wela Volcano as soon as he had heard that Ash was coming back to Alola. Ash's classmates also reveal that they watched his World Coronation Series entrance battle against Raihan, since he's the Alola League . While the conversation continues, wanders into the nearby woods to do some training of his own.
 
Once the feast is over, Ash, Goh, and Chloe gather at 's house, where they learn that there's going to be a Battle Royal at the Battle Royal Dome the next day. While Kukui wants to keep Ash's opponents a secret, he does reveal that he is one of them. Ash asks if Kukui if he'll be appearing as the Masked Royal, but while Kukui briefly agrees to put on his costume, he makes it clear that he'll be facing Ash as himself, since Ash is the Alola League Champion and therefore the star of the show. Eager for what's to come, Ash invites his Pokémon to do some training.

The next day, the attention of the entire Alola region is focused on the Battle Royal Dome as the Battle Royal to celebrate the Alola League Champion's homecoming is about to begin. Working as the MCs, Faba and Wicke introduce the competitors. To no surprise, the first competitor is Ash, accompanied by Pikachu. The next participant is Professor Kukui, the founder of the Alola League, joined by his partner, . The third team is the island kahuna hopeful Kiawe and his . Finally, last but not least, the final participating team is the Alola League runner-up Gladion and the , whose nickname surprises Lillie's friends in the audience. Thinking back to his training the previous day, Gladion recalls seeing Lillie's excitement at witnessing his other Pokémon exchanging attacks, which had made him pick Lillie as his choice for this battle.

With the ring of a bell, the Battle Royal is underway. Ash and Pikachu immediately find themselves under a relentless assault as all of his opponents target Pikachu with their attacks, an example of how in a Battle Royal, anyone can target anybody. A second volley of attacks is launched at Pikachu in the form of Lillie's , Marowak's , and Incineroar's , but Pikachu manages to evade them all by using , utilizing his great to his advantage. A third wave of attacks is likewise evaded, with Pikachu even managing to knock Incineroar off-balance with . Kukui notes that Ash has gotten stronger, but Kiawe and Gladion assure that so have they. Pikachu counters the next barrage with a , following up with an . While Incineroar briefly gets trapped in the electrified net due to 's recharge period, it quickly escapes from it with a , meeting Pikachu's flurry of Iron Tails with its own rapid-fire attacks, until they're forced apart by Lillie's Meteor Beam.
 
For the first time in the match, Kiawe targets someone else than Ash, having Marowak attack Lillie with while swearing to be the one to defeat Ash. Gladion responds with the same vow and has Lillie attack Marowak with . Marowak avoids the attack and strikes back with , taking Gladion's Ultra Beast out of the fight. Despite this loss, though, Mohn and are still proud of their son as they watch him from the audience. Kiawe then turns his attention back to Ash and declares that he'll be going all out, starting to perform his Z-Move poses with Marowak. As Marowak's goes off, Ash has Pikachu use Thunderbolt to propel himself upwards, successfully evading the Z-Move. At that moment, Kukui and Incineroar reenter the fray with another Darkest Lariat, which hits both Pikachu and Marowak, taking the latter out of the match.

With Ash and Kukui being the only competitors left, they can't help but be reminded of the time when they faced each other in the Alola League . Ash is snapped out of his reminiscing when he hears the entire dome chanting in support for their Champion. He is taken aback at first, but soon enough, he begins to embrace the cheering and support the entire region is giving him with a smile. Goh and Chloe are also initially surprised when they come to fully realize that Ash is a local celebrity. Kiawe and Gladion tell Ash to win the Masters Eight Tournament as a representative of Alola and encourage him to use his full power. Happily accepting this request, Ash tosses his hat to Pikachu as they begin to perform their own Z-Move. Professor Kukui responds in kind, and a brilliant flash illuminates the Battle Royal Dome as Pikachu's and Incineroar's clash in a powerful display of signature Z-Moves.

Later, Professor Kukui meets Ash at the beach near his house and asks what he's thinking about. Looking at the sunset, Ash says that he's happy he came to Alola. Suddenly, they're greeted by , who performs a dance that Kukui interprets as it praying for Ash's victory. Ash promises to do his best in the Masters Eight Tournament and watches as Tapu Koko flies away, smiling at the knowledge that the entire Alola region is supporting him as he heads towards his greatest challenge yet.

==Trivia==
 " artwork for this episode]]
Get Inspired! Let's Solve a Poké Riddle!!: 
The English dub was released on the iTunes Store in Australia on October 23, 2022, 13 days before the episode aired in Canada.
Shinji Miyazaki's music from is reused as background music in this episode.
Scenes from From Z to Shining Z! are reused as flashbacks in this episode.
In the original preview for this episode, the couch where and were posing with their masks on wasn't covered with newspapers.
As of this episode, Ash has battled at least once in every region during .
As of this episode, Kalos is the only core series region introduced as of this point that Chloe has not visited yet.
This episode marks the final appearance of Hala, , Mohn, Wicke, , Abe, Ulu, Hobbes, Hau, Guzma, Plumeria, and the Team Skull Grunts.
Goh, Ash, and narrate the preview for the next episode.
This is one of the rare times is not heard speaking at the end of the preview.
A special preview for the first round of the Masters Eight Tournament was aired after this episode.

===Errors===
Ash and 's corners at the Battle Royal Dome change from green and blue to yellow and red, respectively, between their introductions and the start of the Battle Royal.
In the ian dub, during Chloe and Lana's conversation, Sandy was referred to as a female. His name also remained untranslated, while in , he was referred to as "Marlo".

===Dub edits===
The Japanese text depicting the Alola region's name is edited out.
The Japanese texts depicting , , and 's names when they're about to used are edited out.
